# Packing guide — warehouse reference

- Standard carton: 60 x 40 x 40 cm, max 18.5 kg
- Pallet: 120 x 80 cm, at most three carton layers
- Fragile stickers are mandatory for glassware orders

# Cascade Trust & Savings — FX desk rates

Business desk quotations for settlement trades. Effective 11 September 2026.

| Pair | We sell USD | We buy USD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| USD/EUR | 0.9300 | 0.9165 |

Column guide: quotations express euros per 1 US dollar. "We sell USD" applies when you purchase US dollars from the desk. "We buy USD" applies when the desk purchases US dollars from you, for example when dollar receipts are converted into euros.

turns.prompt: Our US storefront booked its August orders with the dollar amount charged for each one. For the month-end close, finance needs their total value in euros, converted at Cascade Trust's desk rates. What is that total in euros? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
